name: @tombi-toml/wasm-lib
description: Tombi formatter and linter for WebAssembly

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && cd ../../../rust/tombi-wasm && wasm-pack build --locked --target web --out-dir ../../typescript/@tombi-toml/wasm-lib/dist --out-name tombi_wasm -- --no-default-features --features lib && rm ../../typescript/@tombi-toml/wasm-lib/dist/.gitignore && cp ../../typescript/@tombi-toml/wasm-lib/types.d.ts ../../typescript/@tombi-toml/wasm-lib/dist/index.d.ts
